$comment: How the asset commands draw the logo: the primary logo file holds the wordmark (its first path) and the ribbon mark (the rest), as the playground's brand.ts draws them (LOCKUP 662.6 by 107.5: the mark 119.06 by 107.5 at the left, the wordmark 482.2 by 61.17 from 180.41, 23.08). brand/logo has no clear space, minimum size or exclusion zone, so the commands set none and invent none.
